aspect: Sick leave is shorter than recovery
description: Statutory leave is measured in weeks; joints and soft tissue take months. The gap is absorbed privately.
Dressing, cooking, driving, typing, carrying shopping. The injury is not the pain, it is the four weeks of everything being slower.
energy_note: Not disabled. Just slower at all of it.

description: Six weeks in a cast, three months of physio, and he is right-handed. He works through it badly and nobody at work registers that the quarter was affected.

aspect: Physio is capped before you are better
description: Covered sessions run out at the point where progress is still being made, and continuing is a private purchase.

aspect: Some of it does not fully go
description: A minority of ordinary injuries leave a permanent limp, ache or weakness, and which ones is not predictable from the injury.
energy_note: Same accident, two outcomes, no explanation.
